attrs.title: What it’s like to work with us
Server-Side Tracking questions, answered
attrs.lead: Can’t find your answer? Ask us on a free 30-minute call.

items.question: What is server-side tracking?
items.answer: Instead of every ad platform’s script running in the visitor’s browser, events go to your own server, which forwards them to Google, Meta and others. It’s more reliable and gives you more control.

items.question: Will server-side tracking recover lost conversions?
items.answer: Usually some, because it’s less affected by ad blockers and browser limits. It still respects consent.

items.question: Does server-side tracking cost money to run?
items.answer: Yes, a small hosting cost, depending on traffic. We recommend the right hosting for your volume.
